question: Shared service or embedded library?
why_it_matters: Changes port design, tenancy mechanics and who runs the observation store
options: (a) shared service all modules call; (b) library each module embeds; (c) both via the same value-typed boundary
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Keep the boundary value-typed and transport-neutral so either works (as specified); decide at integration
decision_owner: Anchor Engine team with product owner

question: Are packs platform-wide immutable artefacts or tenant-private, and who may publish one?
why_it_matters: Decides PackRegistryPort scope, approval flow and licence exposure
options: (a) platform-wide published, tenant-activated; (b) tenant-private; (c) both
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: (a) for APG and synthetic packs; publication rights to be set by the product owner

question: Who owns and supplies thresholds, freshness limits, parameters and decision rules for each pack?
why_it_matters: The builder may invent none; the APG pack stays INCOMPLETE until supplied
options: Named policy owner per pack; a configuration record with approval reference
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Product owner to name the policy owner for the APG pack

question: Canonical form and hash scheme for packs
why_it_matters: Fixes pack identity forever
options: (a) the specification's own integer-only canonical JSON + SHA-256; (b) RFC 8785 JCS + SHA-256; (c) other
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: (a), because packs hold only integers and strings; revisit if (b) is preferred by the Anchor Engine team

question: Data-only packs, or packs that may carry code?
why_it_matters: Code in packs would need sandboxing and a larger trust model
options: (a) data only (as specified); (b) code with sandbox and code hash
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: (a) for MIE-1; (b) only by a later change

question: Time granularity
why_it_matters: as_of is a calendar date in this specification; fields needing intraday timing would need instants
options: (a) date only; (b) date or instant
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: (a) for MIE-1; a core version bump if (b) is needed later
status: SPECIFIED AS PROPOSED - PRODUCT-OWNER DECISION REQUIRED

question: Append-only observations versus licence-driven deletion
why_it_matters: A licence may require deletion; replay needs retention
options: (a) tombstone: content withheld, digest retained, replay reports REPLAY_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE; (b) retain regardless
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Not decided; needs the licence terms, which the builder must not invent

question: Licence terms, display and redistribution limits
why_it_matters: The core evaluates status and window only; terms may restrict showing values or sharing across tenants
options: (a) host enforces on display; (b) pack declares a display class the core carries (reference only vs embed)
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Carry the licence reference on every evidence item (specified); enforcement by the host
decision_owner: Product owner; licence owner; Anchor Engine team

question: Limits values (batch, string, series, rule, pack sizes)
why_it_matters: The builder ships no production value
options: Host supplies LimitsConfig
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Test fixtures only in MIE-1

question: How MF-01..13 relate to the core
why_it_matters: The core restates the MarketFeedPort invariants for observations; M6 cannot be changed
options: (a) mapping adapter only (as specified); (b) later revise the port by change control

question: Owned-asset monitoring (HOLD or WATCH intention)
why_it_matters: The luxury use case tracks owned assets; MIE-1 offers BUY and SELL assessments and a signal view (get_signals)
options: (a) get_signals is the monitor view; (b) add a HOLD intention later
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: (a); no luxury design in MIE-1
status: SPECIFIED AS PROPOSED - PRODUCT-OWNER DECISION REQUIRED

question: Section 08 change request: Option A (context only) or Option B (assumption-labelled signal rules)
why_it_matters: Decides whether the APG pack may use SIGNAL_RULES; until decided it is CONTEXT_ONLY and unconnected
options: See the draft change request
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Not for the builder to decide
blocks: any APG consumption of market signals

question: Cost and value hooks: scope and determinism contract
why_it_matters: The slot is specified; implementations and formulas are not
options: (a) slot only in MIE-1; (b) specify the landed-cost adapter now

question: Form of the uncertainty statement
why_it_matters: MIE-1 uses structured counts only; pack-defined qualitative bands would need owner-supplied definitions
options: (a) counts only; (b) owner-defined bands
status: SPECIFIED AS PROPOSED - PRODUCT-OWNER DECISION REQUIRED

question: Reuse RecordStorePort (EDR-02) with record kinds, or new store ports?
why_it_matters: Reuse needs record-kind authorisation (EDR-20) and append-only semantics that EDR-02 may not give
options: (a) reuse with kinds; (b) new ports
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Not decided; depends on the Anchor Engine team

question: Should read-only operations also fail closed when the audit sink is down?
why_it_matters: v0.1 said yes for all operations but its audit interface could not support list_audit; v0.2 specifies the corrected interface (MIE-R-40, -60, -61, -62)
options: (a) all operations fail closed (as specified); (b) reads degrade

question: How are owner approval references verified?
why_it_matters: The core cannot approve packs
options: (a) host ApprovalVerifierPort backed by an approval record; (b) route through the Governor
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Not decided; the Governor link is a question for the Anchor Engine team

question: Is the outcome vocabulary sufficient for future packs?
why_it_matters: Adding an outcome is a core vocabulary change
options: Keep closed (specified) or allow pack-declared labels mapped to core outcomes
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Keep closed
status: SPECIFIED AS PROPOSED - PRODUCT-OWNER DECISION REQUIRED

question: Reuse or mirror apg.repro?
why_it_matters: The core cannot import APG; the replay discipline is the same
options: (a) mirror in the core and wrap in APG later (as specified); (b) extract a shared module by change control

question: Is the event-class vocabulary complete?
why_it_matters: Three event classes are specified; others need a vocabulary version
options: Keep closed or extend before approval
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Keep closed
status: SPECIFIED AS PROPOSED - PRODUCT-OWNER DECISION REQUIRED

question: Cross-source comparison and divergence signals
why_it_matters: Only conflicts inside a pack-declared comparison group are specified
options: Add a divergence signal later
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Defer

question: Reference implementation language and runtime
why_it_matters: The specification is language-neutral; APG is Python; the Anchor Engine stack is not known to the builder
options: (a) Python following the APG repository; (b) as the Anchor Engine team requires
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: (a) subject to the Anchor Engine team's confirmation

question: Atomicity between an audit append and a store commit
why_it_matters: The core orders append-then-commit and attempts a FAILED event on a later store failure (MIE-R-61) but cannot make the two atomic
options: (a) host supplies an atomic audit-and-commit; (b) the specified ordering with a FAILED event; (c) both
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: Open. (b) is the ordering the specification is written to; whether it suffices, or (a) or (c) is needed, is the design decision that blocker BLK-01 requires before implementation is authorised. Not decided here

question: Audit of refusals whose tenant context cannot be verified
why_it_matters: No tenant can be named, so the core writes no tenant event (MIE-R-40)
options: (a) no event (as specified); (b) a host-level security log outside the core; (c) a core port for unattributed events
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: (a) with (b) as a host responsibility

question: Who runs the ingestion driver and the feed adapters, and where
why_it_matters: The flow is specified (MIE-R-66) but not who triggers it or where it runs; that is a deployment choice (RUL-MIE-07)
options: (a) an Anchor Engine scheduler; (b) a separate service; (c) caller-driven
builder_recommendation_not_a_decision: No recommendation: deployment is not decided here

question: Is the structural, position-based definition of signal influence acceptable?
why_it_matters: MIE-R-63 labels an outcome DIRECT or PRECEDENCE by rule position, which can over-state influence and cannot under-state it
options: (a) structural definition (as specified); (b) a narrower definition needing a materiality judgement the core cannot make
